21.pattern: kubeadm upgrade: drain → kubeadm → kubelet → uncordon, per node

clues.q: Upgrade the control plane node to Kubernetes `1.35.2`
clues.means: Control plane first: kubeadm upgrade apply v1.35.2

clues.q: Then upgrade the worker node `node01`
clues.means: On node01: kubeadm upgrade node (not apply)

clues.q: Drain each node before upgrading it and make it schedulable again afterwards
clues.means: k drain … --ignore-daemonsets before, k uncordon after

traps: Skipping apt-get update → apt says the version is not found
Minor upgrade (1.34 → 1.35) without changing v1.34 → v1.35 in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/kubernetes.list
Running kubeadm upgrade apply on the worker — workers use kubeadm upgrade node
Forgetting apt-mark unhold/hold, so apt refuses to install
Forgetting daemon-reload + restart kubelet, so VERSION stays old
Running k drain/uncordon on node01 (no kubeconfig there) — exit back to the control plane first

verify.see: VERSION v1.35.2 on controlplane and node01

memorise: k drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data   # always on the control plane
apt-get update; apt-cache madison kubeadm   # exact text, e.g. 1.35.2-1.1
apt-mark unhold kubeadm; apt-get install -y kubeadm=1.35.2-1.1; apt-mark hold kubeadm
kubeadm upgrade plan; kubeadm upgrade apply v1.35.2   # worker (after ssh node01): kubeadm upgrade node
apt-mark unhold kubelet kubectl; apt-get install -y kubelet=1.35.2-1.1 kubectl=1.35.2-1.1; apt-mark hold kubelet kubectl
systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl restart kubelet
exit   # back from node01; then k uncordon <node>

22.pattern: etcd snapshot save (with certs) + restore + repoint hostPath

clues.q: which runs at `https://127.0.0.1:2379`
save it to `/opt/etcd-backup.db`
configure etcd to use it
clues.means: In etcd.yaml change the etcd-data hostPath to /var/lib/etcd-restored

traps: Using the peer-cert/peer-key files instead of server.crt/server.key
Changing --data-dir or the mountPath instead of only the hostPath path
Panicking when kubectl is silent for ~60 s after saving etcd.yaml
Using etcdctl snapshot restore — removed in etcd 3.6 (Kubernetes v1.35); restore with etcdutl

verify.cmd: k get pods -n kube-system | grep etcd

memorise: docs: 'etcd backup' → Operating etcd clusters
grep -E 'trusted-ca-file|cert-file|key-file' /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml

etcdctl snapshot save /opt/etcd-backup.db --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 --cacert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt --cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt --key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key
etcdutl snapshot restore /opt/etcd-backup.db --data-dir=/var/lib/etcd-restored
vim /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml   # etcd-data hostPath path: /var/lib/etcd-restored
